steps: Use Python3, Emscripten 3.1.46 and the recorded pinned source archives.
Build the VecX seed according to its prior report or compile each frontend from its pinned source archive with the recorded date and GIT_VERSION.

The external driver downloads and hashes pinned core archives, applies explicit version metadata make overrides, captures compiler dependencies, links one frontend at a time, and compares both resources directly.
Each profile commands array records full make/configure/link invocation. Fresh core compile capture and retained frontend object evidence distinguish compiled and reused inputs.

Retain the original pinned JS/WASM files at the baseline report paths for direct comparison. CMake profiles also require their recorded build-plan.json, clean version metadata shim, pinned vendor archives and documented source transformations.

limitations: Exact runtime reconstruction establishes an executable source/input recipe. Historical CI job and container identity remain unresolved.
SDK files are hashed from the installed SDK. Independent SDK source and distribution reconstruction remain open.

Dependency capture inventories compiler headers and source inputs. Shared SDK inventory records an installed-file snapshot, while exact linker flags and response content remain in each retained build log.
Component-specific final-code notice mapping remains open. Every catalog sourceMapping remains unverified.

driverRecoveryEvidence.scope: An experimental formatter damaged four external Python scripts. The current task command ledger restored each original byte-for-byte against its prior recorded SHA256 and size. Stable Black formatting preserves the Python AST, and a fresh QuickNES reconstruction independently revalidates command arguments and both original runtime files.
